description:
Daily Home Inspection videos showing the crazy things i find during house inspections that's not right! My name is Frank and i have been a home inspector for over 10 years in Canada. Hopefully my videos will entertain you enough to keep coming back for more.

A Membership is only $1

If you are new here, welcome.
If you have been here with me since the beginning, thank you for sticking around.

Please remember to Subscribe, Like each video and make a Public Comment on each video. It helps me out a lot!
